metadata.title: Aika World – World
metadata.description: Travel across the regions of Aika and discover the histories and landscapes that shape the world.

title: The world of Aika
intro: Each region offers unique challenges, alliances and secrets that influence every chapter of the narrative.

north.title: Northern plateaus
north.description: Harsh climates and alliances between nomadic tribes define survival and trade.

central.title: Central city-states
central.description: The heart of Aika's civilization, where magic and technology shape everyday life together.

isles.title: Southern isles
isles.description: Ancient ruins, active volcanoes and hidden harbors await explorers and adventurers.

callToAction.title: Join the journey
callToAction.description: Help shape the world and share your own stories with the community.
